Cigars & the ritual around them

AM issuePrices checked Tue Oct 20, 2026 (morning scan)

Boxes worth laying down, honest-value bundles, and well-made tools. Every comparison is against observed street price—not an ornamental MSRP.

Availability note. Eleven desk entries were price-checked for this issue — all eleven verified live Tuesday morning, October 20, 2026 (morning scan) across JR Cigar, Thompson Cigar, CigarBid, Cigars.com, Famous Smoke, Fox Cigar, and Gotham Cigars, plus named street-reference sources; all 11 are unique listings. Discounts use live street prices only. One entry is a CigarBid live auction — the price shown is the bid-to-win total including shipping at check time, not a fixed price, and the bid may rise before the close time shown on the card. Four entries ship without a confirmed listing photo: three Thompson Cigar listings whose pages expose only a placeholder image, and the CigarBid lot, whose imagery is demonstration-only. Stock, sale windows, auction bids, shipping, and checkout totals may change after the check.

Affiliate disclosure. The Ledger may earn a commission from qualifying purchases through tagged eBay and Amazon links, at no extra cost to the buyer. Other merchant links remain plain.

Collectible ≠ guaranteed return

The investment desk is an asking-price snapshot, not a resale forecast. Each listing names its comparison source and shows condition and completeness where the scan confirmed them.

Price integrityThe investment desk names its comparison basis on every card — live Chrono24 dealer listings for this issue’s two investment references, named in full: the Audemars Piguet Royal Oak 15510ST.OO.1320ST.07 (Sarasota Watch Company — full set, original box and papers; the street comp is the .01 suffix variant, a 2024 dial variant of the same core reference) and the Patek Philippe Aquanaut 5167A-001 (The Watch Boss Of Boca, Chrono24 dealer — watch only, no box or papers). Compare condition, seller type, completeness, shipping, and import costs before treating any asking-price gap as a deal.
LiquidityEstimate how broad the resale market is and how quickly similar pieces actually move.
CompletenessBox, papers, original parts and service records can matter disproportionately.
Ownership dragBuyer premium, tax, servicing, insurance and selling fees belong in the thesis.

Market data, not financial advice. No appreciation claims. Watches are illiquid collectibles; values can fall, provenance can be wrong, and servicing can erase an apparent discount.

03 / OPEN QUESTIONS

Verify before buying

Availability, auction bids, checkout pricing, seller terms, warranty coverage, exact condition, and expiring coupon terms can change after the AM scan.

Liquidity, defined. Each watch carries the Ledger's liquidity read — High: deep resale market, typically sells in days at market price; Good: active market, typically sells in weeks at a fair price; Thin: narrow buyer pool, longer to sell. It's an editorial assessment from comparable listings, price band, and condition — a guide to how fast you could get out, not a resale guarantee.
